source.albumTitle: The Magic Touch of Floyd Cramer

dedupeText: mid century piano virtuoso album cover 1960s piano tuxedo black background slab serif sans serif high contrast vintage vinyl subject positioned in the lower left third facing right toward the instrument text block balanced against the large negative space of the piano lid yellow and white typography popping against a solid black background geometric dashed lines creating a horizontal frame for the primary title combine a high contrast profile portrait against black with a top heavy left aligned typographic block using a slab serif sans serif pairing and geometric line accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio photograph of a male pianist in a dark suit seated at a black grand piano, set against a deep black void. The composition is anchored by a dense block of multi-layered typography in the top left quadrant, framed by decorative dashed borders.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the lower-left third, facing right toward the instrument
Text block balanced against the large negative space of the piano lid
Yellow and white typography popping against a solid black background
Geometric dashed lines creating a horizontal frame for the primary title
coreInvariants: High-key lighting on the subject's face and hands
Strict horizontal alignment of text blocks
Primary accent color of warm yellow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Pianist occupies the lower-left quadrant at roughly 40% scale; piano extends into the lower-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, yellow slab-serif name in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the yellow title, moves down through the tracklist, follows the pianist's gaze to the piano keys, and rests on the instrument's silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the center and upper-right, emphasizing the spotlight effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright White (Secondary text and shirt cuffs)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden Yellow (Primary name and decorative lines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low color saturation, except for the single yellow accent.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses extra-bold slab-serif with high stroke contrast
Secondary text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif
Tight letter spacing in the main title
All-caps for the primary name and tracklist
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'the magic touch of' in a bold, rounded sans-serif
Uppercase name in a condensed, heavy slab-serif with thin horizontal serifs

anatomy.strokeCharacter: uniform verticals with thin horizontal serifs

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, condensed slab-serif paired with wide, geometric sans-serif for structural contrast.
graphicDevices: Horizontal dashed lines (film-strip style) in red and yellow
Small bullet points separating list items

avoid: Serif fonts for the body text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Stymie Black or Rockwell Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif display style

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Franklin Gothic Wide or Venus Extended
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century geometric sans-serif body text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a man in a 1960s dark suit playing a black grand piano, side profile, looking slightly toward the camera with a smile. The background is pure solid black. High-contrast lighting on the face and hands. The top third of the image is empty black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a left-aligned text block in the top left. Use a bold yellow slab-serif for the main name, framed by horizontal dashed lines. Place white geometric sans-serif text below it in a clean block.

verificationChecks: Is the primary name in yellow slab-serif?
Are there dashed horizontal lines framing the title?
Is the subject positioned in the lower-left?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (e.g., cyan or orange instead of yellow)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's head
Check that the yellow is vibrant and not muddy
Verify the dashed lines are perfectly horizontal
Confirm the pianist's hands are visible on the keys
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast profile portrait against black with a top-heavy, left-aligned typographic block using a slab-serif/sans-serif pairing and geometric line accents.
